function.name: execute
function.description: Run any shell command in a working directory (defaults to the project root) and see stdout, stderr, and exit code. Large output may be truncated to a head+tail preview with metadata.

cwd.description: Optional working directory to run in (defaults to the project root). Relative paths are resolved against the project root.

function.name: read
function.description: Read a file from disk. Large files may be truncated to a head+tail preview with metadata. Optionally pass start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to read only a specific line range.

start_line.description: Optional start line (1-based, inclusive). Must be provided with end_line.

end_line.description: Optional end line (1-based, inclusive). Must be provided with start_line.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file (parent directories are created automatically)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit an existing file. Mode 1 (default): replace an exact old_text block with new_text, where old_text must appear exactly once. Mode 2 (range): when start_line and end_line are provided, replace that whole line range with new_text.

old_text.description: Exact text to replace (required in exact-match mode)

start_line.description: Optional start line (1-based, inclusive) for range mode. Must be provided with end_line.

end_line.description: Optional end line (1-based, inclusive) for range mode. Must be provided with start_line.

function.name: memory_read
function.description: Read a memory entry from scoped memories. Scope is optional: if omitted, read falls back from project to system. Leave name blank to read indexes.

name.description: Memory entry name without .md extension; leave blank for indexes

function.name: memory_write
function.description: Write or update a memory entry in scoped memories. Scope is required: project or system. Use the `name` parameter for the entry name (use `name`, NOT `path` — the file tools use `path`); each scope's index.md is auto-maintained (one managed line per entry); use name "index" to write the index file verbatim. If the user asks to save guidance for the current model only, pass current_model_only: true to save a model-specific overlay.

scope.description: Scope to write into: project or system

description.description: Optional short description appended to the managed index line

current_model_only.description: Set true to save this entry as a model-specific overlay for the current model only (<name>.<model>.md); it is auto-appended when the entry is read under that model and never listed in the index.

function.name: task_create
function.description: Start a background task for a long-running shell command. Returns task id and output path for later inspection.

command.description: Shell command to run in the background

cwd.description: Optional working directory (defaults to project root)

env.description: Optional JSON object of environment overrides; use this for PATH or tool-specific variables

function.name: task_get
function.description: Get full metadata for a task by id. Use read on output_path to inspect command output.

function.name: task_list
function.description: List all background tasks in the current workspace with current status.

function.name: task_stop
function.description: Stop a running background task by id.

function.name: task_wait
function.description: Wait for a background task to finish. Polls every 0.5s until completion, a log pattern matches, or timeout. Timed-out waits include a bounded output tail.

tail_lines.description: Log lines to return when timing out or matching a pattern (default: 10, max: 100)

done_pattern.description: Optional regular expression that returns early when it matches the recent log output

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Fetch the content of a URL (HTML or text) and return cleaned text. Handles HTML by stripping scripts/styles and extracting visible text. Returns error messages for invalid URLs or HTTP errors.

function.name: register_reminder
function.description: Register a periodic reminder. The harness injects a [SYSTEM:] message into your next idle turn when the reminder is due.

description.description: What should happen when this reminder fires

interval_minutes.description: How often to remind (1-1440 minutes, i.e. up to 1 day)

function.name: cancel_reminder
function.description: Cancel a previously registered reminder so it stops firing.

function.name: ask_user_question
function.description: Ask the user a structured qualification question. Supports single/multi selection plus optional freeform/Other input. Prefer this over plain numbered lists when you need a clear choice. The harness renders it natively and returns {selected, freeform}.

question.description: The question to ask the user

multi_select.description: Allow selecting multiple options (comma-separated in TUI). Default false.

allow_freeform.description: Allow freeform/Other text alongside selection. Default false.
